ann.t: We wish to inform you that Asarfi Hospital Limited has scheduled a Conference Call with Analysts / Investors on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 04:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss the Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

Asarfi Hospital Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve The Board shall consider and approve the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026.
